name: jira-bug-dashboard-cloud
description: Cloud edition of Jira Bug Dashboard: Cloudflare Worker + D1 + Cron + Web Push, Atlassian OAuth 2.0 (3LO).

scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --env dev
scripts.dev: npm run build && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --env dev && wrangler dev --env dev --test-scheduled
scripts.deploy:dry: npm run build && wrangler deploy --env production --dry-run --outdir .wrangler/dry
scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --env production && wrangler deploy --env production
